name: agent-board
description: Live side panel for Claude Code: the main session, advisor, subagents, reviewer verdicts, shell calls and a session log. A model is shown as seen answering, or marked as configured when only your settings name it

openOnStart.title: Open on session start
openOnStart.description: Open the agent board by itself when a session starts. Off: open it with /agent-board.

reviewerAgent.title: Reviewer agent name
reviewerAgent.description: The subagent type whose report ends with a VERDICT: APPROVED or VERDICT: REJECTED line. The board shows that line as the reviewer's verdict.
